name: Goal-Based-Portfolio-Allocation-System-main
description: Goal-Based Portfolio Allocation System (FastAPI backend + Vite/React frontend)

scripts.backend:install: cd backend && if exist venv rmdir /s /q venv && py -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run frontend:install && npm run backend:install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
